en.abdullah-al-shahin: (7) Muhammad bin Hammam narrated from Ja’far bin Muhammad bin Malik from Abbad bin Ya’qoob from Khallad as-Sa’igh that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said:
“The rising of as-Sufyani is inevitable. He will rise in Rajab.” A man asked: “O Abu Abdullah, when he rises, what shall we do?” He said: “When he rises, you are to keep to us (Ahlul Bayt).”
